column1: # Water plants (base:seagrass, base:lily_pad, kelp's top, base:reed), two options a plant: row a and row b.
# Generated with BLOCK_LIKE=kelp,cattail,reeds,water_hyacinth (the game's water plants as the third reference).

column3: seagrass|plant|Eelgrass (seagrass) growing on the sea floor: a tight clump of 8-10 long narrow ribbon blades, each 1-2 px wide, rising from the bottom edge and curving gently as if in a slow current, the tallest about 28 px, mid green (#2f5a26 #3f7a32 #5a9a40 #7ab654) with a paler line down the lit blades, bold simple shapes
column4: lily_pad|flat|Lily pad: one round floating water-lily leaf about 26 px across, a narrow V notch cut from its rim to its centre, glossy green (#2e5a26 #3e7630 #548f3c #6faa4c), a few faint veins radiating from the centre, a slightly darker rim and the lit upper left side paler
column5: kelp_top|plant|The top of a kelp column, matching the attached kelp exactly (the same olive-brown #4a4a1c #6a6a28 #8a8a3a, stalk width and ribbon fronds): the stalk rises from the bottom edge at its middle (x 15-17, as the kelp below it), carries two small round air bladders, and ends 6-8 px below the top edge in a spray of three long wavy ribbon blades that taper to points
column6: reed|plant|Common reed: three or four tall slender grey-green stems (#5a6e3a #708a48 #8ca45a) with long narrow leaves slanting out from them, each stem topped by a soft feathery plume, purple-brown and buff (#5e4a48 #7e6656 #a89070), the plumes leaning a little to one side, about 30 px tall

column3: seagrass_b@-|plant|Seagrass on the sea floor: 6-7 broader ribbon blades, 2-3 px wide, rising from the bottom edge and swaying all one way as if in a current, the tips bending over, the tallest about 26 px, fresh bright green (#3a6a2a #4f8a36 #6aa646 #8cc25e), bold simple shapes
column4: lily_pad_b@-|flat|Lily pad with a flower: one round floating water-lily leaf about 24 px across, a narrow V notch cut from its rim to its centre, glossy green (#2e5a26 #3e7630 #548f3c #6faa4c), and on it one small white water-lily flower about 9 px across, pointed white petals (#f4f0e4, shaded #d8d2c4) round a yellow centre (#e8c040)
column5: kelp_top_b@-|plant|The top of a kelp column, the same olive-brown as the attached kelp (#4a4a1c #6a6a28 #8a8a3a): the stalk rises from the bottom edge at its middle (x 15-17) and ends about 10 px below the top edge in one larger round float bladder from which four long ribbon blades stream up and to one side, wavy, tapering to points
column6: reed_b@-|plant|Common reed in late summer: three tall slender straw-green stems (#6a7040 #8a8c50 #aaa868) with long narrow leaves slanting out, each topped by a dense drooping tan-gold plume (#7a6040 #a08458 #c8ac7a), about 30 px tall, bold simple shapes
